pages.title: Item list
pages.preview: <wax-item-list id='gallery-item-list' movable></wax-item-list><script type="module">document.getElementById('gallery-item-list').items = [{ key: 'apple', icon: '🍎', name: 'Apple', note: 'red or green' }, { key: 'banana', icon: '🍌', name: 'Banana', note: 'from far away' }, { key: 'cherry', icon: '🍒', name: 'Cherry', note: 'in summer' }];</script>

pages.title: Combobox
pages.preview: <wax-combobox id='gallery-combobox' placeholder='Pick a city...'></wax-combobox><script type="module">document.getElementById('gallery-combobox').choices = ['Oslo', 'Lima', 'Kyoto', 'Cairo', 'Quito'].map(city => ({ value: city.toLowerCase(), label: city }));</script>

pages.title: Floating card
pages.preview: <wa-button id='gallery-floating-button' size='s'>Open the card</wa-button><wax-floating-card id='gallery-floating-card' close-label='Close'>A card next to what was clicked.</wax-floating-card><script type="module">const button = document.getElementById('gallery-floating-button'); button.addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('gallery-floating-card').toggle(button));</script>

pages.title: Ask each
pages.preview: <wax-ask-each id='gallery-ask-each' label='Overwrite?' question='Overwrite' light-dismiss></wax-ask-each><wa-button id='gallery-ask-button' size='s'>Ask about two files</wa-button><script type="module">const ask = document.getElementById('gallery-ask-each'); ask.describe = file => `"${file}"?`; ask.labels = { yes: 'Overwrite', no: 'Skip', yesAll: 'Overwrite all', noAll: 'Skip all', cancel: 'Cancel', progress: '{n} of {total}' }; document.getElementById('gallery-ask-button').addEventListener('click', () => ask.ask(['apples.txt', 'bananas.txt']));</script>

pages.title: List manager
pages.preview: <wax-list-manager id='gallery-list-manager' search-placeholder='Search...' new-label='New' style='max-height: 12rem'></wax-list-manager><script type="module">const people = [{ key: 'ada', icon: '🙂', name: 'Ada', note: 'Oslo' }, { key: 'bruno', icon: '🙂', name: 'Bruno', note: 'Lima' }, { key: 'carla', icon: '🙂', name: 'Carla', note: 'Kyoto' }]; const manager = document.getElementById('gallery-list-manager'); manager.items = people; manager.addEventListener('wax-query', event => { manager.items = people.filter(person => person.name.toLowerCase().includes(event.detail.query.toLowerCase())); });</script>

pages.title: Map picker
pages.preview: <wax-map-picker id='gallery-map-picker' lat='41.3874' lon='2.1686' zoom='12' style='--map-picker-height: 12rem'></wax-map-picker><small id='gallery-map-picked'>Click the map to move the point</small><script type="module">const picked = document.getElementById('gallery-map-picked'); document.getElementById('gallery-map-picker').addEventListener('wax-pick', event => { picked.textContent = `Picked ${event.detail.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${event.detail.lon.toFixed(4)}`; });</script>
